September, 2026
Proposal to Pollo Campero
We are excited to grow our partnership with Pollo Campero. The Genius software and hardware solutions enable businesses to transform food service experiences and keep guests coming back. Our Genius Digital Menu Board (DMB) solution is an excellent fit to your immediate need.
However, for the future of your business and long-term strategy of vendor consolidation, we believe the combination of Genius + Worldpay gives you the ability to consolidate vendors and bundle capabilities. With our integrated cloud-based platform including point of sale, back office, digital menu signage, kiosk and customer engagement solutions, we strongly believe collaboration with Genius will provide you with not only a best-in-class experience through our Digital Menu Board (DMB) solution, but a roadmap to more vendor consolidation by adopting the rest of our platform where and when it makes operational and economic sense.
We thank you for your time and we welcome the opportunity to share thoughts and cultivate new ideas that will help further differentiate in a crowded marketplace.
Here is what you will find in the enclosed RFP response:

It is with much enthusiasm that we submit our response to Pollo Campero Digital Menu Boards Request for Information.
Pollo Campero is the destination customers seek for a unique food experience that’s full of life, seasoned with a little zest, and a flavor that’s more than skin deep—that’s bold, complex and a little unexpected. And like Pollo Campero, we too offer bold, complex and unexpected solutions to help you consolidate your vendor stack and remove costs. Global Payments, together with our Genius platform, holds the advantage of combining innovative restaurant technology, payments, and an unmatched international scale under one relationship.
From Digital Menu Boards (DMB) to POS systems, and Kitchen and Back Office solutions, our Genius platform powers businesses from street eats to stadium seats. That’s why we are eager to show how uniquely experienced we are to be your new DMB provider to support all current and future locations. Our solutions are built to be fault-tolerant, both in the physical store locations and in the cloud, to ensure that your restaurants can transact business, prepare, and serve customers without interruption.
It’s this flexibility that can allow you to start with our DMB solution without being required to replace your existing technology, while retaining the ability to consolidate additional capabilities with us over time. A sound flexibility today, consolidation opportunity tomorrow approach allows you the best opportunity to remove costs and innovate your business now and into the future. As a 42-year veteran of the Enterprise Restaurant business with solutions that meet every restaurant’s technology need and backed by a global payments company for financial stability, we believe we are exceptionally positioned and experienced to meet and exceed Pollo Campero’s business objectives. Within our responses in the RFP evaluation worksheets, and in the related attachments, we want to instill your trust in the following points of difference:

Executive Summary
Genius Digital Menu Boards
Genius Digital Menu Board allows you to update pricing, promotions and menu content in real-time across indoor, outdoor, pre-sell and confirmation displays. It’s directly integrated with POS and pricing tools, ensuring consistency and agility in QSR, fast casual and cafes.
But furthermore, DMB is just one component of a full stack of technology designed for the QSR space. Rather than adding another standalone vendor to the mix, add a capability to a partnership that can grow with Pollo Campero.
Genius can solve the immediate DMB requirement, integrate with your existing environment, support your domestic and international growth, and give you the option to consolidate restaurant technology and payments over time, where doing so reduces complexity and creates better economics.
Key benefits include:
Boosted customer order size Guests spend more when influenced by dynamic menus.
Real-time remote updates Instantly update prices, specials or sold-out items with centralized control across multiple locations.
Customization Tailor menu boards by time, location and guests.
Highlight promos Spotlight seasonal and high-margin items, promote combo deals, loyalty programs and more.
Durability Provides commercial-grade displays built for long hours and different environments.
Immersive and mighty Our indoor electronic menu boards set the standard with vivid, realistic picture quality and HD resolution, and a thin bezel size and screen thickness for a sleek look.
Genius Digital Menu Board software is built for ease and speed. It features a no-code, drag-and-drop interface that allows operators to update menu items, pricing, images and promotions without needing technical support. The intuitive UI enables quick scheduling of the menu. Whether you’re managing one location or hundreds, the experience is designed to be fast, scalable and user-friendly for busy teams.
The Winning Formula for Pollo Campero
Genius gives Pollo Campero a strong solution for your DMB requirements while creating a foundation for broader vendor consolidation, integrated restaurant technology and payments and international growth over time.
Our DMB solutions, developed, deployed and supported by Global Payments provide:
Multiple solutions for both immediate, mid-term, and long-term needs.
The technical know-how to work around-the-clock to solve for different scenarios.
The deepest support of people across a breadth of functions to develop solutions for Pollo Campero.
Our solutions are built on an open API architecture that supports integrations with many different third-parties for both pricing and OCU integrations. This affords us some flexibility to work with impactful, existing third-parties like Oracle and NCR.
Additional capabilities that make Genius a “fit” for Pollo Campero
In-House, seasoned Project Management resources.
Proven ability to scale rollouts - domestically and internationally.
Network of certified installation technicians.
Integrated with leading delivery providers and 100’s of other service partners.
Warehouses with staging, shipping, depot, kitting, etc. across U.S./Canada.
Hardware “Break/Fix” support.
24/7/365 technical support.
Multiplying What’s Possible
Bringing more value to Pollo Campero
Global Payments and Worldpay have joined forces. This means broader capabilities, greater reach, accelerated innovation and more expertise to support merchants and partners at every stage of their growth. Explicitly for you, this provides access to innovative restaurant technology, powerful payments abilities, broader commercial scale and international capabilities through one strategic relationship. The solutions and services we're known for aren't going anywhere. And now it provides a worthy incentive to consolidate your vendors to one, meeting one of your corporate objectives.
Global Payments is joining forces with Worldpay, multiplying what’s possible for our clients and partners by focusing our resources toward a single vision — to ignite business growth and enrich lives around the world.
Our combined capabilities and capacity allow us to deliver more products and services to merchants of all sizes across the globe. In an industry where scale and distribution capabilities matter more than ever, we are well positioned for growth opportunities.
Our combined talent has the innovative spirit and expertise to anticipate what our clients need, and we are putting all our energy and expertise into building feature-rich products and distinctive service experiences.
Importantly, the products clients rely on, including flagship solutions like Genius and Worldpay’s ecommerce capabilities, are now even better together.

Our platform seamlessly handles both Card Present (CP) and Card Not Present (CNP) transactions, ensuring reliable and secure payment solutions for a wide range of business needs. Site Surveys
Describe and price the site-survey process for existing and new restaurants, including mounting, electrical, network, sight lines and environmental conditions.
Yes. Each location deployment begins with a kickoff email/meeting with restaurant stakeholders, during which the site survey is scheduled. During this kick-off, all the information needed for the assessment will be communicated by the Genius team, like: number, type, and location of devices, electrical architecture of the site, environmental conditions inside and out, sight lines, and more.
Each location should have a site survey so the Genius team members can understand its operations and use cases. The site survey also generates the initial hardware recommendations for the restaurant team to review.
Compatibility Assessment
Indicate whether the proposed solution can reuse or adapt to existing equipment or whether new equipment is required. Identify assumptions and site validation needed.
Yes. Genius can generally support the reuse of Pollo Campero’s existing digital menu board displays, subject to verification of the installed equipment and its remaining useful life. In many cases, new display hardware is not required.
As part of the discovery and site assessment process, Genius will evaluate the manufacturer, model number, age, condition, and capabilities of the existing displays to determine the most appropriate deployment architecture and recommend the best long-term solution. Depending on the equipment and its expected lifespan, existing displays may be reused with a Genius media player/controller or, where supported, through a controllerless deployment model.
To assess compatibility, we would request details regarding the make and model of the displays, as well as any additional information needed to validate connectivity, mounting, power requirements, network infrastructure, and overall system compatibility. Based on this assessment, Genius will identify which components can be retained and provide recommendations that balance reliability, performance, and total cost of ownership.
In scenarios where existing displays are not natively supported for controllerless deployment, Genius can provide a controller-based solution that maximizes the value of the current display investment. Our media player architecture supports dual-display output, enabling a single device to power two menu board displays. This approach can significantly reduce hardware, installation, and ongoing support costs compared to deploying a dedicated player for each screen, while still delivering a fully featured digital menu board experience.
This flexible deployment model allows Pollo Campero to leverage existing assets wherever practical, minimize capital expenditures, and maintain a scalable foundation for future growth and technology enhancements.

Provide order confirmation directly on the drive-thru menu screen and integrate it with the POS. Speakers and microphones are out of scope.

Cloud CMS
Provide centralized cloud CMS for content, pricing, promotions, dayparting, scheduling, user access, device monitoring and reporting.
Yes. The Genius platform provides a fully centralized, enterprise-grade CMS designed to support the complete lifecycle of menu board content management across all domestic restaurant locations. Within a single interface, authorized users can create, manage, schedule, publish, and roll back content using intuitive content layout tools and streamlined deployment workflows built into the native CMS.
Content creation is powered by flexible layout templates and dynamic publishing tools, while scheduling capabilities enable precise control over when and where content is displayed. The platform’s deployment engine ensures reliable distribution of content to all assigned locations, and built-in rollback functionality allows users to quickly revert to prior versions if needed—ensuring operational continuity and minimizing risk.
In addition, Genius offers managed services options for organizations that require additional support. Our team can assist with or fully manage content operations on behalf of Wingstop, including content updates, scheduling, and deployment execution. This provides scalability and ensures consistent, high-quality content delivery even during periods of limited internal bandwidth or increased demand.
Together, these capabilities deliver a centralized, scalable, and reliable solution for menu board content management across the entire restaurant network.

Support & Maintenance
Provide help desk, SLAs, remote diagnostics, monitoring, escalation, field service and hardware-replacement protocols.
Yes. Genius supports ongoing operations with documented incident plans, defined escalation paths, and proactive monitoring and alerting for the Genius platform.
For critical issues, the Genius Support Team follows documented plans covering internal escalation and customer notifications; when a possible Sev1 event is detected (via automated alerts or increased case volume), it is escalated to DevOps, Production Support, and R&D, a Sev1 bridge line is opened for remediation, and customer notifications are sent as agreed with the customer.
Detection, escalation, and communications are supported by configurable near-real-time alerts (SMS, email, and programmatic events) across Sales/Operational Events, Payroll, Hosting/Cloud Operations, and 3rd Party Integrations. Monitoring integrates with enterprise tools including LogicMonitor, ElasticSearch (log alerting & APM), and vendor-specific tools, with automated routing across 1st-, 2nd-, 3rd-level, and engineering teams based on severity. During severe problems, outage notifications are sent to clients, and external Slack channels are used for real-time communication.
Our customers typically chose incident SLAs for response time and resolutions times based on their business needs. We can also customize them, to provide faster times during live events. Our typical Support SLAs include a 90 second Average Speed of Answer (ASA) and a 5% Abandon Call Rate. Total Genius Solution
The Value of Full Genius Solution
One unified partner for payments, POS, Back Office, and more.
While completely optional for Pollo Campero, implementing the full Global Payments Genius solution delivers a unified, cloud-based platform that brings all core QSR commerce capabilities into a single ecosystem. Since we’re giving you information on our DMB solution, we wanted to take a few pages to restate the power of the complete Genius QSR stack.
By combining POS hardware, software, and payments into one integrated solution, businesses can streamline operations—from order entry and checkout to inventory and employee management—while supporting omnichannel selling across in-store, online, and mobile environments. This consolidation eliminates fragmented tools, reduces complexity, and enables a more consistent, high-quality customer experience.
Genius also directly drives revenue growth and customer engagement by expanding payment flexibility and enabling modern commerce experiences. Businesses can accept all major payment types—including contactless, mobile wallets, and gift cards—ensuring they meet evolving customer preferences, while features like loyalty and marketing integrations help increase repeat business. At the same time, next-day funding and flexible pricing options improve cash flow, and can help offset processing costs, delivering measurable financial benefits.
Finally, the platform is designed to scale and support long-term business success with enterprise-grade security, flexibility, and service. PCI-compliant infrastructure with encryption and tokenization protects sensitive payment data, while the cloud-based architecture enables real-time visibility and management from anywhere. Whether adding new devices, locations, or channels, Genius adapts to evolving needs, supported by tailored onboarding and 24/7 expert assistance. The result is a future-ready commerce foundation that reduces risk, improves efficiency, and empowers sustained growth.
Revenue Potential of Genius
The full Genius solution boosts revenue by removing friction across the entire buying and selling experience—making it easier for customers to spend more, and for businesses to capture every sale.
1. Capture more sales across every channel
Genius enables businesses to sell in-store, online, and on the go within a single platform, ensuring no missed revenue opportunities regardless of where customers prefer to shop. By supporting all major payment types, including contactless, mobile wallets, and global digital payment methods, it reduces checkout friction and increases conversion rates. When customers can pay quickly and easily with their preferred method, they are more likely to complete purchases and spend more per transaction.
2. Increase average ticket size and repeat business
Marketing, loyalty, and gift card capabilities can help businesses actively drive higher spending and customer retention. Promotions and loyalty incentives encourage upsells and repeat visits, while seamless customer experiences, especially in restaurants and retail, improve satisfaction and lifetime value. Over time, this leads to more frequent transactions and higher average order values, directly contributing to revenue growth.
3. Improve speed, efficiency, and throughput
By streamlining operations, from order entry to payment processing, Genius allows businesses to serve more customers in less time. Faster checkout lines, synchronized front and back of house operations, and mobile POS capabilities help increase transaction volume, especially during peak periods. The ability to take payments anywhere (e.g., kiosks, handheld devices) also helps capture incremental sales that might otherwise be lost due to long wait times or limited checkout capacity.
4. Protect and expand margins
Finally, Genius improves net revenue by optimizing costs and cash flow. Combined with flexible pricing and scalable infrastructure, businesses can grow revenue without proportionally increasing costs, improving overall profitability.
Bottom line: Genius doesn’t just process payments—it actively creates revenue by increasing conversion, boosting customer spend, enabling faster transactions, and improving margins.
Additional Security for your Business
The full Genius solution improves security by embedding enterprise-grade protections directly into every step of the payment and transaction lifecycle—reducing risk while maintaining a seamless customer experience.
1. End-to-end protection of payment data
Genius uses end-to-end encryption and tokenization to secure sensitive cardholder data from the moment of capture through processing. This ensures that payment information is never exposed in readable form, effectively eliminating opportunities for interception or misuse. By replacing raw card data with tokens, businesses minimize their exposure to breaches and significantly reduce the scope of sensitive data stored in their environment.
2. Built-in PCI-compliant infrastructure
The platform is designed to meet PCI-DSS compliance standards, which are the industry benchmark for payment security. This means businesses leveraging Genius benefit from a system that is already aligned with strict regulatory requirements for handling payment data. As a result, organizations reduce their compliance burden, avoid potential penalties, and maintain trust with customers who expect secure transactions.
3. Reduced risk through a unified ecosystem
By consolidating POS, payments, and management tools into a single, integrated platform, Genius eliminates the need for multiple third-party systems, which can introduce vulnerabilities. Fewer integration points mean fewer gaps for potential cyber threats. Additionally, Genius actively blocks third-party access to payment data, creating a more controlled and secure environment compared to fragmented solutions.
4. Secure cloud-based management and monitoring
Because Genius is cloud-based, businesses gain secure, real-time oversight of transactions and operations from anywhere. This centralization improves visibility into suspicious activity, enables faster response to potential threats, and ensures updates and security patches are deployed automatically, keeping the system protected against emerging risks without requiring manual intervention.
Bottom line: Genius improves security not just with individual features, but through a layered, integrated approach—combining encryption, compliance, controlled access, and cloud-based oversight to protect both the business and its customers while enabling confident, secure growth.

Genius Digital Menu Boards
Genius Digital Menu Board allows you to update pricing, promotions and menu content in real-time across indoor, outdoor, pre-sell and confirmation displays. It’s directly integrated with POS and pricing tools, ensuring consistency and agility in QSR, fast casual and cafes.
But furthermore, DMB is just one component of a full stack of technology designed for the QSR space. Rather than adding another standalone vendor to the mix, add a capability to a partnership that can grow with Pollo Campero.
Genius can solve the immediate DMB requirement, integrate with your existing environment, support your domestic and international growth, and give you the option to consolidate restaurant technology and payments over time, where doing so reduces complexity and creates better economics.
Key benefits include:
Boosted customer order size Guests spend more when influenced by dynamic menus.
Real-time remote updates Instantly update prices, specials or sold-out items with centralized control across multiple locations.
Customization Tailor menu boards by time, location and guests.
Highlight promos Spotlight seasonal and high-margin items, promote combo deals, loyalty programs and more.
Durability Provides commercial-grade displays built for long hours and different environments.
Immersive and mighty Our indoor electronic menu boards set the standard with vivid, realistic picture quality and HD resolution, and a thin bezel size and screen thickness for a sleek look.
Genius Digital Menu Board software is built for ease and speed. It features a no-code, drag-and-drop interface that allows operators to update menu items, pricing, images and promotions without needing technical support. The intuitive UI enables quick scheduling of the menu. Whether you’re managing one location or hundreds, the experience is designed to be fast, scalable and user-friendly for busy teams.
The Winning Formula for Pollo Campero

Our DMB solutions, developed, deployed and supported by Global Payments provide:
Multiple solutions for both immediate, mid-term, and long-term needs.
The technical know-how to work around-the-clock to solve for different scenarios.
The deepest support of people across a breadth of functions to develop solutions for Pollo Campero.
Our solutions are built on an open API architecture that supports integrations with many different third-parties for both pricing and OCU integrations. This affords us some flexibility to work with impactful, existing third-parties like Oracle and NCR.

In-House, seasoned Project Management resources.

Network of certified installation technicians.
Integrated with leading delivery providers and 100’s of other service partners.

Yes. We offer demonstrations and virtual training formats and will work closely with your teams to ensure a thorough knowledge transfer. We look forward to discussions regarding on-site training support.
Self-serve training can be launched directly from within the software.  Instructor-led training is available as needed, depending on the subject matter.
Genius Academy (our LMS) is provided at no cost and tracks completed training and certifications. We build curricula to certify learning groups on necessary functions and features.
Training materials include video links and documentation links to specific topics. We also provide user guides and other training content which can be made available on your LMS portal/platform.
Post-implementation training from our Product Education Team works with business leaders and subject matter experts to scope the need, design instruction, create the learning schedule, determine the assessment process, and evaluate the materials.
Support & Maintenance
Provide help desk, SLAs, remote diagnostics, monitoring, escalation, field service and hardware-replacement protocols.
Yes. Genius supports ongoing operations with documented incident plans, defined escalation paths, and proactive monitoring and alerting for the Genius platform.
For critical issues, the Genius Support Team follows documented plans covering internal escalation and customer notifications; when a possible Sev1 event is detected (via automated alerts or increased case volume), it is escalated to DevOps, Production Support, and R&D, a Sev1 bridge line is opened for remediation, and customer notifications are sent as agreed with the customer.
Detection, escalation, and communications are supported by configurable near-real-time alerts (SMS, email, and programmatic events) across Sales/Operational Events, Payroll, Hosting/Cloud Operations, and 3rd Party Integrations. Monitoring integrates with enterprise tools including LogicMonitor, ElasticSearch (log alerting & APM), and vendor-specific tools, with automated routing across 1st-, 2nd-, 3rd-level, and engineering teams based on severity. During severe problems, outage notifications are sent to clients, and external Slack channels are used for real-time communication.
Our customers typically chose incident SLAs for response time and resolutions times based on their business needs. We can also customize them, to provide faster times during live events. Our typical Support SLAs include a 90 second Average Speed of Answer (ASA) and a 5% Abandon Call Rate. While we work with each client to determine the best support model, below is an example of common SLAs.
During Live Event
Priority 1: Issue that causes a severe operational impact to the location/stand [Response - 15 minutes; Resolution - 90 minutes].
Priority 2: Issue that causes a significant impact to location/stand [Response - 30 minutes; Resolution - 2 hours].
Standard
Priority 1: Issue that causes a severe operational impact to the location/stand [Response - 1 hour; Resolution - 4 hours].
Priority 2: Issue that causes a significant impact to the location/stand [Response - 2 hours; Resolution - 8 hours].
Priority 3: Issue that causes minor/no impact to the location/stand [Response - 4 hours; Resolution - 24 hours].
Priority 4: Other / Customer Inquiries [Response - 12 hours; Resolution - 48 hours].
For additional information, please refer to the Ongoing Support section of our Executive Summary above.
Hardware & Software Warranty
State coverage periods, inclusions, exclusions, RMA/replacement process and any extended-warranty pricing.
Yes. Our hardware warranty coverage is 3 years for all hardware/devices included in pricing/hardware quotes. Hardware continues to be supported after the warranty period; devices outside of warranty have a replacement cost.
In-Store Music
Describe and price separately, including hardware, licensing, implementation and recurring fees.
In-store music is currently not a standard component we offer, but we look forward to further discovery to understand how we can assist with this, or other value-rich components for Pollo Campero.
Guest Wi-Fi
Describe and price separately, including hardware, implementation, management, security and support.
Guest Wi-Fi is currently not a standard component we offer, but we look forward to further discovery to understand how we can assist with this, or other value-rich components for Pollo Campero.
Billing Frequency & Payment Terms
Describe the proposed payment schedule and payment terms, including any advance payment, deposit, milestone billing, invoice timing and payment due dates (e.g., Net 30).
Yes. We can accept NET60 payment terms.

sections.heading: Total Genius Solution
sections.text:
The Value of Full Genius Solution
One unified partner for payments, POS, Back Office, and more.
While completely optional for Pollo Campero, implementing the full Global Payments Genius solution delivers a unified, cloud-based platform that brings all core QSR commerce capabilities into a single ecosystem. Since we’re giving you information on our DMB solution, we wanted to take a few pages to restate the power of the complete Genius QSR stack.
By combining POS hardware, software, and payments into one integrated solution, businesses can streamline operations—from order entry and checkout to inventory and employee management—while supporting omnichannel selling across in-store, online, and mobile environments. This consolidation eliminates fragmented tools, reduces complexity, and enables a more consistent, high-quality customer experience.
Genius also directly drives revenue growth and customer engagement by expanding payment flexibility and enabling modern commerce experiences. Businesses can accept all major payment types—including contactless, mobile wallets, and gift cards—ensuring they meet evolving customer preferences, while features like loyalty and marketing integrations help increase repeat business. At the same time, next-day funding and flexible pricing options improve cash flow, and can help offset processing costs, delivering measurable financial benefits.
Finally, the platform is designed to scale and support long-term business success with enterprise-grade security, flexibility, and service. PCI-compliant infrastructure with encryption and tokenization protects sensitive payment data, while the cloud-based architecture enables real-time visibility and management from anywhere. Whether adding new devices, locations, or channels, Genius adapts to evolving needs, supported by tailored onboarding and 24/7 expert assistance. The result is a future-ready commerce foundation that reduces risk, improves efficiency, and empowers sustained growth.
Revenue Potential of Genius
The full Genius solution boosts revenue by removing friction across the entire buying and selling experience—making it easier for customers to spend more, and for businesses to capture every sale.
1. Capture more sales across every channel
Genius enables businesses to sell in-store, online, and on the go within a single platform, ensuring no missed revenue opportunities regardless of where customers prefer to shop. By supporting all major payment types, including contactless, mobile wallets, and global digital payment methods, it reduces checkout friction and increases conversion rates. When customers can pay quickly and easily with their preferred method, they are more likely to complete purchases and spend more per transaction.
2. Increase average ticket size and repeat business
Marketing, loyalty, and gift card capabilities can help businesses actively drive higher spending and customer retention. Promotions and loyalty incentives encourage upsells and repeat visits, while seamless customer experiences, especially in restaurants and retail, improve satisfaction and lifetime value. Over time, this leads to more frequent transactions and higher average order values, directly contributing to revenue growth.
3. Improve speed, efficiency, and throughput
By streamlining operations, from order entry to payment processing, Genius allows businesses to serve more customers in less time. Faster checkout lines, synchronized front and back of house operations, and mobile POS capabilities help increase transaction volume, especially during peak periods. The ability to take payments anywhere (e.g., kiosks, handheld devices) also helps capture incremental sales that might otherwise be lost due to long wait times or limited checkout capacity.
4. Protect and expand margins
Finally, Genius improves net revenue by optimizing costs and cash flow. Combined with flexible pricing and scalable infrastructure, businesses can grow revenue without proportionally increasing costs, improving overall profitability.
Bottom line: Genius doesn’t just process payments—it actively creates revenue by increasing conversion, boosting customer spend, enabling faster transactions, and improving margins.
Additional Security for your Business
The full Genius solution improves security by embedding enterprise-grade protections directly into every step of the payment and transaction lifecycle—reducing risk while maintaining a seamless customer experience.
1. End-to-end protection of payment data
Genius uses end-to-end encryption and tokenization to secure sensitive cardholder data from the moment of capture through processing. This ensures that payment information is never exposed in readable form, effectively eliminating opportunities for interception or misuse. By replacing raw card data with tokens, businesses minimize their exposure to breaches and significantly reduce the scope of sensitive data stored in their environment.
2. Built-in PCI-compliant infrastructure
The platform is designed to meet PCI-DSS compliance standards, which are the industry benchmark for payment security. This means businesses leveraging Genius benefit from a system that is already aligned with strict regulatory requirements for handling payment data. As a result, organizations reduce their compliance burden, avoid potential penalties, and maintain trust with customers who expect secure transactions.
3. Reduced risk through a unified ecosystem
By consolidating POS, payments, and management tools into a single, integrated platform, Genius eliminates the need for multiple third-party systems, which can introduce vulnerabilities. Fewer integration points mean fewer gaps for potential cyber threats. Additionally, Genius actively blocks third-party access to payment data, creating a more controlled and secure environment compared to fragmented solutions.
4. Secure cloud-based management and monitoring
Because Genius is cloud-based, businesses gain secure, real-time oversight of transactions and operations from anywhere. This centralization improves visibility into suspicious activity, enables faster response to potential threats, and ensures updates and security patches are deployed automatically, keeping the system protected against emerging risks without requiring manual intervention.
Bottom line: Genius improves security not just with individual features, but through a layered, integrated approach—combining encryption, compliance, controlled access, and cloud-based oversight to protect both the business and its customers while enabling confident, secure growth.
Genius POS
Upgrade to a modern, cloud-based point of sale designed for enterprise quick service and fast casual restaurants. With centralized management, real-time data sync, and offline mode, you’ll keep transactions flowing in any environment — and deliver top-notch customer experiences every time.
Genius handles high volume without breaking a sweat. Take orders with speed and precision, process payments across every channel and increase the operational efficiency of even the most complex environments.
It's everything a traditional POS offers — and much more. Genius Enterprise POS delivers deep vertical integration with operations and workflows. It’s designed with point-of-sale software functionality that supports centralized management, flexible hardware configurations, and robust APIs to connect with kitchen automation, loyalty programs and enterprise IT systems, making it ideal for high-volume, multi-location businesses.
Genius Cloud POS
Hardware and OS Agnostic
Genius Cloud POS can run on any hardware platform and operating system (Windows, Android, iOS) - a claim unique to the product in the QSR industry. This allows for ultimate flexibility in offerings to your operators while being able to run a unified platform across your system.
Ease of Deployment
Lower complexity of the Genius POS application implementation reduces the cost and need for highly technical personnel within your organization to roll out across the organization. Operators no longer need to rely on in-store personnel performing register updates to update menu items or prices they can push updates 24/7. Genius POS interacts with the Genius Portal and digital menus seamlessly. This allows for an easy install for new sites, upgrading an existing site to new software, or changing configurations at a site.
No Servers Needed
Thanks to our patented peer-to-peer data sync capabilities, no servers or master terminals are needed at the site. Terminals are in constant communication through UDP to ensure 100% data integrity on site while maintaining cloud connection for backup. This cuts down on costs and eliminates single points of failure.
Ease of Integration
Our cloud architecture makes integrations more accessible to third parties as Genius leverages microservices that take the burden off the in-store application
Genius POS has an ever-growing number of existing integrations built on Restful APIs
The Genius POS modern architecture and programming languages are supported by large software development communities
Global Payments is eager to create strategic partnerships with companies that can help bring new technologies to our customers across the globe
Genius Back Office
Run a More Profitable Restaurant
More than 10,000 Enterprise QSR locations rely on Genius Back Office (formerly RTIconnect) and Mobile Restaurant Management to cut the fat out of food and labor costs and supersize profits.
Genius offers a different kind of back office that’s easy to use in-store or on the go.  Our powerful above store reporting will give you actionable information at your fingertips.
Key features include:
Cloud-powered, hardware agnostic
Enterprise-grade
Role-based task lists help people focus on what’s important
Access from mobile app or browser
Powerful food cost and inventory tools help control costs and waste; food 
cost variance accurate to the ounce
Automated scheduling optimizes staffing, saves time, and helps manage 
labor costs
One click to approve and send employee schedules
Graphical summaries with one-click drill-through give insights at a glance
Back Office with Enterprise Reporting
Run a more profitable restaurant
Inventory, Food Cost Management
Control food costs and waste without the guessing
Labor & Scheduling
Optimize staffing and manage labor costs
Genius Handheld POS
Pollo Campero can access store and restaurant tools remotely, allowing you to monitor operations and make updates from any location.
The handheld POS reduces unnecessary steps for servers, enabling you to focus more on guest service and complete tasks more efficiently.
The handheld POS can be deployed easily across new locations, supporting growth without major operational changes.
Connectivity options (Wi-Fi, 4G/5G cellular, Bluetooth) 
Secure payments 
Suggestive upselling features 
Real-time reporting | Takeout and delivery order management 
Dynamic discounting features 
Marketing & loyalty programs 
Printed and digital receipts
Genius Kiosk
Self-ordering kiosk machines are interactive touchscreen devices that allow customers to place orders without needing to queue up or interact directly with staff.
Genius Kiosk lets guests take control of their experience, offering fast, accurate and personalized ordering designed to handle peak traffic with ease. Reduce wait times, improve order accuracy and alleviate front-of-house pressure — all while increasing bill averages with Genius.
Integrated with a POS system, kiosks streamline the checkout process and make ordering faster and more accurate.
Genius Kitchen Management
Genius Kitchen, our kitchen management system, offers smart workflows, custom routing, user-friendly kitchen display systems and real-time insights that keep your restaurant operations in sync from front to back of house and across all your locations. Best of all? It’s designed to seamlessly integrate with Genius Enterprise POS.
This is a cloud-based digital platform that streamlines and automates back-of-house operations, centralizing functions for kitchens like order management (including online ordering), recipe control, menu engineering, food prep tracking, labor optimization, inventory tracking and reporting.
Display orders by prep station, priority or channel
Role-based screens
Sync in real time with POS, drive-thru tech and more
Recipe management
Recipe management across locations and tracks modifications in real time.
Order routing in real time
Dynamically directs incoming orders to the right kitchen stations to balance capacity, minimize delays and maintain smooth operations.
Inventory management
Monitors ingredient usage automatically, reducing waste through accurate tracking, and triggers timely reordering to keep kitchens supplied.
Load balancing
Distributes workload evenly across multiple preparation stations to prevent bottlenecks and maintain optimal efficiency.
